stn_including_me.accept_text:
Camp stores. Went off the stair into the water back when the mangroves still came up to the wall, and the crocolisks moved in after, which is the only reason it is still down there. Four bundles, whatever is left dry inside them. Watch the toads more than the lizards. A toad out there does not look like anything at all until it is on you.

They went in at Mistvale Lagoon, south of our gate.

stn_the_stair_ends_in_a_socket.accept_text:
The stairwardens hold the middle flights and they hold them properly, in reliefs, which is not a thing I have seen a jungle troll bother to do. Get through enough of them to work past the second landing, and bring me stone. Loose course stone off the stair itself, the old grey stuff, from where it has fallen and not from where it is still laid.

The stair is Zul'Marosh Steps, east of Grom'gol on the far side of the Green Cut.

stn_nobody_left_who_built_it.accept_text:
The Rotvine call themselves keepers of that stair. They are not. They are sitting in a house calling themselves the family. Their vinespeakers carry knot-cord, which is a record, and I want five of them off them. I want you to hear me say that I am asking you to take a people's writing off their bodies, because I am not going to pretend to you that it is less than that.

You will find them on Zul'Marosh Steps, east of here, above the stairwardens.

stn_the_long_way_round.accept_text:
This is a favour and I am asking it as one. There is a courier pouch out on the causeway short of the fen landing, in the rot where the creepers sit. Get out to the landing, get the creepers off the ground, and look where the gangplank meets the bank. I have not reported it. I would rather go on not having reported it.

Rotvine Fen is on the far east side of the jungle, a long way from this gate.

stn_four_reports_and_a_boot.accept_text:
There is a tuber in the fen rot. Pale, about a thumb long, and it will pull water out of anything you pack it against. Seven, and they sit under the standing water, which means the toads - and a toad out there is a stone until it is on your back. I cannot condemn a boot. I can keep a foot dry inside one, and I have a ward of eleven men who would take that trade before breakfast.

Rotvine Fen. East, as far as the jungle goes before it turns to water.

stn_the_long_haul.accept_text:
No roost in a morning's flight, fine. Then we go in one hop and we go far. Over the water, up the whole length of the coast, Tarren Mill in Hillsbrad. A wyvern that flies that does not eat on the way, it eats before, and that means pressed feed, the heavy blocks, boar fat and jungle grain beaten together until it goes hard. Six blocks. The rootgrubbers give you the fat. The thornbacks will try to take it back off you, because they have been robbing my feed store since the day the store existed.

Rootgrubbers and thornbacks both keep to the Green Cut, east of the gate.
